author: Dominic Gutoman
title: Victims’ families hope document dispute won’t delay ICC trial
content:
Victims’ families are hopeful that the trial will continue as the fourth status conference of Rodrigo Duterte’s alleged crimes against humanity before the International Criminal Court (ICC) concluded on October 13.

“This is important for us, because we are closely watching for justice to prevail through the ICC,” Dahlia Cuartero, mother of victim Jesus Cuartero, told the media in Filipino. “Justice here in the Philippines is hopeless.”

Duterte attended the status conference for the second time. The ICC Trial Chamber III discussed the preparations, including matters involving witnesses, evidence, disclosures, and the schedule of the first week of trial.

Similar to the previous status conference, ICC Presiding Judge Joanna Korner asked the prosecution to review the relevance of documents to avoid duplication.

The ICC Senior Trial Lawyer Julian Nicholls said that they have a team of analysts and experts that reviewed each document presented for trial.

The prosecution will also use government data like Philippine National Police (PNP) records and the accomplishment report of the Presidential Communications Operations Office (PCOO) to present the number of killings during Duterte’s presidential term.

Korner flagged the defense for its seeming uncooperation in examining documents and the dataset presented by the prosecution. The prosecution offered multiple times to examine the documents but to no avail. They also proposed an independent expert to assist in the review.

“The prosecution is making all attempts to assist you (in examining the documents), and you’re just refusing it,” Korner said.

British lawyer Peter Haynes, lead legal counsel of Duterte (defense), said that there are some incidents in the documents that may be irrelevant to the case.

“We haven’t got the resources to go through 35,000 pages of Rule 77 material, to find all the cases in which these things were properly investigated, all the cases in which there is no relationship to the war on drugs at all, and that’s what we have to do,” Haynes said.

The ICC judges said that it could not yet impose an arbitrary limit on evidential items that the prosecution could present as it could violate their disclosure obligations.

“We take the view that the prosecution should review the database and any other documentation that it’s proposing, which in its possession, to indicate clearly to the defense what documents or materials could be considered exculpatory. I think that is the main and overarching task that the prosecution must carry out,” Korner ruled.

For Duterte Panagutin Network Europe, Duterte’s right to a fair trial should not be used as an excuse to delay the proceedings.

“The victims’ families cannot be made to wait indefinitely while the Defense wages procedural battles to delay the proceedings,” the network said in a statement.

The fifth status conference in the International Criminal Court (ICC) crimes against humanity case against former President Rodrigo Duterte is tentatively on November 2.

“The victims and their families have already waited too long, and they deserve a process that moves forward in good faith and upholds the timely administration of justice,” the network said.

The official start of trial is on November 30, after the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I unanimously confirmed all three counts of crimes against humanity against Duterte.

The ICC will be prosecuting cases related to the “drug war” during Duterte’s term as mayor and vice mayor of Davao City, and as the former president of the Philippines. The scope of the killings was limited between November 1, 2011, up to March 16, 2019, when the Philippine government was still a member of the Rome Statute.

“What we want is for the hearing to continue to hold Duterte accountable for his crimes and while he is still able,” Pasco said in Filipino. “We wish for him to be strong until the end of the trial so we could get the justice we deserve.” (AMU, DAA)

title: Lawyer Aba: Öcalan’s freedom and status must be secured
content:
The physical freedom of Abdullah Öcalan is being highlighted as essential for advancing the Peace and Democratic Society Process and building lasting peace. Those advocating this position stress that the process should not be limited to legal reforms. They argue that creating conditions in which Öcalan can work freely would strengthen channels of dialogue and negotiation, help build public trust and pave the way for a democratic solution.


Lawyer Murat Aba, representative of the Human Rights Foundation of Turkey (TIHV) in Diyarbakır (Amed), spoke to ANF about the importance of securing Abdullah Öcalan's physical freedom and clarifying his status within the Peace and Democratic Society Process.


‘Support from those opposed to the process is important’


Murat Aba drew attention to the position of the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) in the process, arguing that support from groups traditionally opposed to such initiatives could also influence their own supporters.


Aba said: “The nature of the Nationalist Movement Party, and the fact that those who would normally be most opposed to such processes are now managing and guiding this one, creates an opportunity for them to influence their own supporters. In other words, bringing those most opposed to the process closer to it makes things easier. Although nationalist attitudes exist in Turkey, developments of this kind can proceed more smoothly within Turkish society in certain circumstances.


Let me give just one small example. When TRT Kurdî was established in Turkey, I believe it was initially called TRT Şeş, if I remember correctly. From the perspective of society, this meant that a state television channel was being established in a language unfamiliar to many Turks. Moreover, this was not a private channel. Its costs and expenditure were covered by public funds. Yet we did not see any serious opposition at the time. We might have expected demonstrations or reactions such as, ‘How can you allow Kurdish to be used on state television?’


Similarly, when the Nationalist Movement Party supported this process, it partly stemmed the wave of nationalism. Of course, there are also problems involving other sections of society, but they might not have been quite so critical.”


‘You must reach a solution with the party you are in conflict with’


Murat Aba stressed the importance of Abdullah Öcalan's physical conditions and status, saying that experiences of conflict resolution around the world demonstrate the need for direct dialogue between the parties to a conflict.


He said Öcalan's role and position must be clarified if the process is to move forward. Aba also said, “This is a fundamental principle, and examples from around the world demonstrate it. You must reach a solution with the party you are in conflict with. Ultimately, there is talk of the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) laying down its arms and becoming integrated into the process. Abdullah Öcalan was its leader, and the solution must be reached with him. That was, in fact, the first step of the process. However, Abdullah Öcalan's status must also be determined because the process needs to continue.


Abdullah Öcalan is still being held in isolation. Yes, we are hearing reports that his conditions have changed. I should also point out that we only know as much about this issue as we have learned from the press. However, you cannot manage a process as you wish from a place of isolation. That is why there is a demand for Abdullah Öcalan's status to be formally defined.”


‘Physical freedom and status must be addressed together’


Murat Aba stressed that Abdullah Öcalan's status must be determined alongside securing his physical freedom.


Aba continued: “When we look at his physical conditions, this is directly related to the right to hope, as you mentioned. The right to hope is also recognised by the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR). A person should not be subjected to a sentence with no defined end. Such sentences must be reviewed at certain intervals. The question is whether the sentence should continue or not. That is what this issue is about.


Physical freedom would allow him to communicate more easily with all sections of society. It would enable people, opinion leaders and individuals from different backgrounds to meet with him more freely. For all these reasons, physical freedom is important. Beyond that, he must also have a defined status. This is, in fact, at the heart of the matter.”

author: Unknown
title: The opportunity for democratization must not be missed
content:
The leadership of the Kurdistan Freedom Movement, which Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan has described as the “Communalist Comradeship Movement,” issued a new and highly significant statement on 8 October regarding the Peace and Democratic Society Process. Announcing that it had withdrawn its guerrilla forces from within Turkey’s borders and evacuated four tunnels in Metîna, the movement’s leadership stated that “there are now no guerrilla forces left that pose a threat to Turkey.”


Undoubtedly, the decision to dissolve the PKK and end its strategy of armed struggle, the act of 30 guerrillas burning their weapons on 11 July 2025, and the steps taken throughout 2025 to withdraw forces that faced a risk of clashes inside Turkey and along the border are all historically significant for advancing the Peace and Democratic Society Process. The steps taken in late September and early October 2026 are equally important. All of these developments demonstrate how seriously the Kurdish side is approaching the process and how courageously it is taking the practical steps that the process requires.


Those familiar with the situation closely point out that, in fact, the issue of “disarmament” has been “essentially resolved” through these steps. This reveals that the frequent calls by AKP spokespersons and the Turkish state’s special-war media insisting that “disarmament must be completed” have largely lost their meaning. Under the current circumstances, there are no further steps the guerrillas can take beyond what they have already done. Spokespeople for the Kurdistan Freedom Movement have already stated this situation very clearly and unequivocally.


Indeed, how are the Kurdistan Freedom Guerrillas, who live in mountainous areas along the Iraq–Iran border amid ongoing war, supposed to lay down their arms under the present conditions? How could they protect themselves in such an environment without weapons or adequate preparation? It is obvious that, in these circumstances, any guerrilla who lays down their arms would have to return to Turkey immediately. But how could a disarmed guerrilla return to Turkey under the current legal framework? Wouldn’t new legal arrangements suited to such a return have to be introduced? Isn’t it clear that anyone returning under the existing legal framework would be arrested and imprisoned?


The Turkish Republic state and the AKP government are taking no steps toward establishing the necessary legal arrangements. Worse still, they are not even putting these arrangements on the agenda or discussing them. Instead, they engage in bombastic rhetoric, primarily aimed at deceiving Turkish society, insisting that “the organization must lay down all its weapons.” Moreover, it remains entirely unclear whether the state and the AKP government genuinely want the PKK to disarm completely. If no armed PKK forces remain on Iraqi territory, the Turkish state would then also have to withdraw its military forces from Iraq and Syria. It is difficult to argue that such a development would be desirable from the perspective of state policy and the AKP government.


On the other hand, it is also unclear whom the state and the AKP government intend to disarm. The so-called “framework law,” which is virtually impossible to implement in many respects, is equally unworkable in this regard. This is because it is claimed to apply not only to Turkish citizens but also to citizens of Syria, Iraq, and Iran. In other words, Turkey seeks to apply its laws to citizens of other states as well. All that seems to matter is that they are Kurdish and carry weapons! It is as though the moment the authorities see an armed Kurd anywhere, they immediately demand, “Lay down your weapons!” But in that case, will they also demand that the peshmerga of the KDP and PUK lay down their arms? After all, they too are armed Kurds and would therefore fall within the scope of the law introduced by Turkey and the policies pursued by the AKP government.


This is how deeply contradictory and complicated the approach of the Turkish state and the AKP government to the Peace and Democratic Society Process has become. That is precisely why they have yet to take any serious practical steps of real significance. It is worth noting that no meaningful steps have been taken toward the physical freedom of Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan]. author: Aline Melo
title: A Meta está barrando conteúdos políticos nas eleições, mas deixando robôs agirem
content:
A poucos dias do segundo turno das eleições de 2026, a atuação da Meta na moderação de conteúdos políticos tem gerado denúncias sobre restrições à liberdade de expressão e à circulação de informações durante a campanha — e acusada de tratar de forma diferenciada os conteúdos de grupos que disputam a presidência do Brasil.


Um levantamento da

CTRL+Z

 ao qual a

Agência Pública

 teve acesso documentou mais de mil casos de restrições e banimentos nas plataformas da empresa na primeira quinzena de outubro, dos quais 22% envolvem contas ou publicações censuradas sem explicação. Segundo o documento, a Meta, responsável por Instagram, Facebook, Threads e WhatsApp, é acusada de remover publicações, desativar contas e limitar o alcance de conteúdos sem apresentar justificativas claras ou oferecer mecanismos acessíveis de contestação.


Entre os registros, o tipo mais frequente é a perda de alcance, com 356 ocorrências, seguida por restrições de repostagem (163), restrições de conta (125), banimentos de publicações (119) e banimentos de contas (116). O levantamento também identificou 101 casos classificados como indeterminados, além de bloqueios de conta (40), redução de visibilidade nas buscas (38), restrições de comentários (36), banimentos relacionados a comentários (22), restrições de impulsionamento (14) e comentários ocultados (13).


Para Yasmin Curzi, professora e pesquisadora de direito digital na FGV Rio, as denúncias indicam uma possível assimetria no tratamento de diferentes setores políticos. “Estamos vendo que essas suspensões não afetam todos os espectros políticos igualmente, mas sim setores progressistas, imprensa independente, movimentos sociais e políticos de esquerda”, afirma.


A Federação Nacional dos Jornalistas (FENAJ)

denunciou

, ainda em junho, a derrubada de perfis ligados à mídia independente às vésperas do período eleitoral. Em outro episódio, em 23 de setembro, a Meta

desativou

 a conta de anúncios da campanha de reeleição do presidente Lula, sem explicar publicamente os motivos da decisão.


Durante o primeiro turno, a empresa

afirmou

 ter removido publicações de ministros, jornalistas e militantes para cumprir decisões do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). Segundo as denúncias reunidas pelo levantamento, porém, as remoções ocorreram sem aviso prévio, justificativas individualizadas ou canais acessíveis de recurso. A campanha do PT também

denunciou

 ao TSE restrições na distribuição de publicações de Lula e de perfis aliados, que, segundo a campanha, poderiam comprometer a paridade da disputa com o senador Flávio Bolsonaro.


Curzi avalia que a falta de explicações e de mecanismos efetivos de contestação amplia o poder das plataformas sobre o debate público. “Sem explicação e sem chance real de recurso, a empresa acaba decidindo, na prática, quem pode participar e quem é mais ouvido no debate público”, diz.


A pesquisadora também questiona a ideia de que a desigualdade de alcance entre grupos políticos decorra apenas da capacidade de comunicação de cada campo. Para ela, é necessário considerar o funcionamento das próprias plataformas e seus interesses comerciais, analisando que a Meta tem silenciado sistematicamente atores que contrariam seu modelo de negócio, em um movimento que, segundo sua avaliação, ficou mais evidente após a vitória de Donald Trump nas eleições presidenciais dos Estados Unidos, em 2024.


Denúncia: IA da Meta gera imagens pró-Flávio, mas não pró-Lula


As críticas contra a Meta ganharam ainda mais repercussão nesta quarta-feira, 14 de outubro, quando usuários da internet identificaram diferenças na geração de imagens pela

Meta AI

.


Em vários

testes

, o programa de inteligência artificial produziu imagens com material de propaganda de Flávio Bolsonaro, mas não de Lula. A coligação Brasil Pronto Pra Mais, que apoia a candidatura de Lula, acionou novamente o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) para questionar o funcionamento da ferramenta. O pedido aponta tratamento desigual e também denuncia restrições ao alcance de publicações da campanha petista. Diante das suspeitas de interferência da empresa nas eleições, Lula determinou ainda que sua campanha apresente uma

denúncia

 à Organização dos Estados Americanos (OEA) contra a Meta.


Programa de inteligência artificial da Meta montou imagens de propaganda de Flávio Bolsonaro, mas não de Lula


À Folha, a Meta respondeu ter proibido “temporariamente a recomendação de candidatos ou a geração de imagens deles” …

author: dialogocomospovos
title: II Raízes Payaya: o encontro é cura
content:
Na abertura do II Raízes Payaya, Otto Payaya, da comunidade indígena do povo Payaya, na Chapada Diamantina, destacou a importância dos saberes ancestrais, do cuidado coletivo e da conexão com a natureza como caminhos de cura e resistência.


Realizado de 24 a 27 de setembro, na Cabeceira do Rio Utinga, o encontro dá continuidade a uma iniciativa construída ao longo de dois anos para fortalecer e manter vivas as práticas tradicionais do povo Payaya. Na comunidade, a coleta de cerca de 75 espécies de ervas medicinais contribui para a produção de remédios naturais e para a manutenção de famílias que preservam esses conhecimentos.


Em sua fala, Otto ressaltou que sair das cidades e se aproximar das matas, dos rios e das florestas também é uma forma de cuidar de si. Para ele, a cura não está apenas nos remédios, mas também no acolhimento, nos abraços, nas refeições compartilhadas, nos chás, nas rezas, nos benzimentos, nos cantos e no toré. Práticas ancestrais que, há gerações, fortalecem os vínculos entre os povos e com seus territórios.


Sem desconsiderar os avanços da medicina, o encontro reafirma a importância de preservar os conhecimentos transmitidos pelos mais velhos, reconhecendo que o cuidado vai além do corpo e se constrói na relação com a coletividade e a natureza.


Com rodas de sabedoria, fitoterapia, sementes crioulas e a Tenda de Cuidado, o II Raízes Payaya convida diferentes povos e parceiros dos movimentos sociais a compartilhar experiências e fortalecer esses saberes.


Cuidar é também resistir ao apagamento da memória ancestral. Porque não há luta pela terra e pelo território sem o cuidado com a vida, a cultura e os conhecimentos que mantêm os povos enraizados em sua história.

author: neues deutschland
title: Hugo-Haus Berlin: Bewohner zum zweiten Mal vertrieben
content:
Im September wurde die Gürtelstraße in Friedrichshain geräumt. Nun müssen die Bewohner auch die Zeltstadt gegenüber räumen. Wohin, wissen sie nicht.


Das ehemalige Hostel in der Gürtelstraße hat eine lange Geschichte der Hausbesetzung: 2014 besetzten es Geflüchtete, um für ein Bleiberecht für alle zu demonstrieren.


Das ehemalige Hostel in der Gürtelstraße hat eine lange Geschichte der Hausbesetzung: 2014 besetzten es Geflüchtete, um für ein Bleiberecht für alle zu demonstrieren.


In Berlin wächst mit dem Anbruch der kalten Jahreszeit die Zahl der Wohnungslosen. Nachdem am Dienstagmorgen in der Habersaathstraße im Bezirk Mitte mehrere Menschen geräumt worden waren, mussten am Mittwochmittag die Bewohner*innen des »Hugo-Dorfs« ihr Domizil räumen. So nannten sie die Zeltstadt in der Gürtelstraße, die als Mahnwache angemeldet war. Es sind junge Punks, die zeitweise ein lange leerstehendes Gebäude in der Gürtelstraße 39–41 in Friedrichshain still besetzt hatten.


Nachdem sie Mitte September öffentlich bekanntgegeben hatten, dass sie in dem ehemaligen Hostel wohnten, gab es bald Graffiti und Aufkleber mit dem Slogan »Hugo-Haus bleibt«. So hatten die jungen Bewohner*innen ihr Domizil genannt (»nd« berichtete). Doch die Räumung Ende September konnten sie nicht verhindern. Sie erfolgte, nachdem es Konflikte zwischen den Bewohner*innen und Bauarbeiter*innen gegeben hatte, die im Auftrag des Investors Vorbereitungen für den geplanten Abriss des Gebäudes hatten tätigen wollen.


Seitdem sitzen die Bewohner*innen auf der Straße. Sie hatten sich direkt gegenüber dem nun eingerüsteten und von einem Sicherheitsdienst bewachten Gebäude eingerichtet. »Wir hatten an dieser Stelle schon Mitte September einen Infopunkt eingerichtet«, sagt Andreas, einer der Bewohner, zu »nd«. Nach der Räumung wurde aus diesem Treffpunkt das Hugo-Dorf. Es war für alle Passant*innen zugänglich. Handschriftlich waren dort auf Schildern die Forderungen der Bewohner*innen aufgeschrieben. Sie wollen in das geräumte Haus zurück oder in ein anderes Gebäude, in dem sie alle zusammen leben können. Doch ihre Forderungen wurden von der Politik ignoriert.


»Einige kommen bei Freund*innen unter, manche überlegen, in andere Städte zu gehen. Andere wissen nicht, wo sie bleiben sollen.«


Martina Bewohnerin »Hugo-Dorf«


In den jüngsten Tagen war die Stimmung im Hugo-Dorf gedrückt. Vor allem die Temperaturen, die sich nachts dem Gefrierpunkt nähern, machten den Anwesenden zu schaffen. Unterstützer*innen hatten Schlafsäcke vorbeigebracht, in denen sich mehrere der Menschen auf dem Matratzenlager eingewickelt hatten, als »nd« das Lager besuchte. Ein junger Mann, der seinen Namen nicht sagen will, erwartet von der Politik nichts. »Das sind alles Reformisten«, ruft er nur. »Die kannst du vergessen. Niemand hat unsere Räumung verhindert.« Bewohner Andreas sieht das differenzierter. »Wir müssen weiter aktiv bleiben«, sagt er. Es gebe Treffen mit Unterstützer*innen aus Friedrichshain und anderen Stadtteilen. Dort würden Pläne für eine neue Demonstration diskutiert.


Mit der Räumung des Hugo-Dorfs werden die Menschen zerstreut. »Einige kommen bei Freund*innen unter, manche überlegen, in andere Städte zu gehen. Andere wissen nicht, wo sie bleiben sollen«, sagt Bewohnerin Martina beim Zeltabbau am Mittwochnachmittag. Dabei kann man sehen, wie gegenüber Wohnraum zerstört wird. Im ehemals besetzten Gebäude sind alle Fenster und Sanitäranlagen herausgerissen. Jetzt wird das Nachbargebäude eingerüstet. Die Grundstücke gehören einer Immobilienfirma.


Vasili Franco, der noch für die Grünen im Abgeordnetenhaus sitzt, kritisiert den Umgang mit den Bewohner*innen. »Für die ehemaligen Bewohner*innen des Hugo-Hauses ist die Situation mittlerweile dramatisch. Die kalte Räumung durch den Eigentümer war absolut unnötig und hat verhindert, dass eine Übergangslösung gefunden wurde«, sagt er zu »nd«. Das Vorgehen habe dazu beigetragen, dass die seelische und körperliche Belastung für die Betroffenen zu einer konkreten Gesundheitsgefährdung führe. »Nur dank der Unterstützer*innen der Mahnwache gegenüber dem Haus konnte in den letzten Wochen ein Überleben sichergestellt werden«, hebt Franco hervor. »In der Gürtelstraße zeigt sich exemplarisch, dass Obdachlosigkeit kein abstraktes Problem ist, sondern eine wachsende soziale Frage, die über persönliche Schicksale entscheidet«, sagt er.

author: Tagesspiegel BZ
title: Polizeieinsatz in linker Hochburg Rigaer Straße: Vermummte Gruppe zündet Barrikaden in Berlin an
content:
In der Nacht zu Mittwoch brennen im Friedrichshainer Nordkiez Barrikaden. Die Polizei reagiert mit einem Großeinsatz, inklusive Hubschrauber.


Kurz vor Mitternacht: Rauch und Flammen über dem Samariterkiez in Berlin-Friedrichshain. Gegen 23:50 Uhr am späten Dienstagabend melden sich Anwohner via Notruf bei der Berliner Polizei. Eine größere Gruppe Vermummter habe Unrat, E-Scooter und Verkehrsschilder auf die Straße geschleppt und angezündet. Videos in den sozialen Netzwerken zeigen lodernde Flammen und eine große Rauchwolke über der Rigaer Straße.


Obwohl die Polizei schnell vor Ort ist und den Löscheinsatz der Feuerwehr begleitet, können die Tatverdächtigen unerkannt flüchten. Auch eine Absuche mit einem Hubschrauber über den Friedrichshainer Dächern bleibt erfolglos, wie der Tagesspiegel von der Berliner Polizei erfuhr. Durch die Flammen wurden der Asphalt der Fahrbahn und eine Straßenlaterne beschädigt.


Bis etwa 1:30 Uhr kam es zu mehreren Straßensperrungen in der unmittelbaren Umgebung der Rigaer Straße. Laut eines Polizeisprechers wurde niemand bei dem Einsatz verletzt, es kam zu keiner direkten Konfrontation zwischen Brandstiftern und Einsatzkräften.


Die Rigaer Straße rund um den autonomen Rückzugsort Rigaer 94 gilt als letzte Hochburg der linksradikalen Szene Berlins. Immer wieder kommt es zu Angriffen auf Polizeikräfte, unter anderem von umliegenden Dächern. Gleichzeitig ist es seit Jahren sehr viel ruhiger geworden im Friedrichshainer Nordkiez. Größere Krawalle, die einst an der Tagesordnung waren, sind zur Seltenheit geworden.


https://www.tagesspiegel.de/berlin/polizeieinsatz-in-linker-hochburg-rigaer-strasse-vermummte-gruppe-zundet-barrikaden-in-berlin-an-16160353.html


Friedrichshain – Wieder Feueralarm in der linken Krawall-Hochburg!

 Vermummte haben am späten Dienstagabend Unrat auf der Rigaer Straße angezündet. Die Flammen schlugen hoch, beschädigten Straßenlaternen. Videos der Brandstiftung kursieren im Internet.


Wie die Berliner Polizei auf B.Z.-Nachfrage bestätigte, ging gegen 23.50 Uhr ein Zeugenhinweis ein. Mehrere Vermummte hatten auf der Kreuzung Rigaer Straße/Liebigstraße Unrat – darunter E-Scooter und -Fahrräder, Einkaufswagen und Gummifüße von Verkehrsschildern – auf die Fahrbahn gebracht und angezündet.


Ein heftiger Brand loderte mitten auf der Kreuzung. Die Feuerwehr brachte das Feuer jedoch schnell unter Kontrolle, verletzt wurde niemand.


Polizei fahndet mit Hubschrauber nach Tätern


Noch in der Nacht startete die Polizei eine großangelegte Fahndung. Streifenwagen suchten nach den Brandstiftern, ein Polizeihubschrauber überprüfte die Dächer der eng bebauten Gegend. Ohne Erfolg: Bislang konnte kein Tatverdächtiger ermittelt werden. Für die Suche wurden die umliegenden Straßen großflächig bis ca. 1.20 Uhr für den Autoverkehr gesperrt.


Erst letzte Woche hatten Unbekannte in der Rigaer Straße brennende Reifen auf die Fahrbahn geworfen und Holz angezündet. Als Polizisten anrückten, eskalierte die Lage: Die Einsatzkräfte wurden von Dächern aus

mit Steinen und Flaschen beworfen und mit Pyrotechnik beschossen.

 Auch da entkamen die Vermummten unerkannt.


https://www.bz-berlin.de/berlin/vermummte-zuenden-unrat-an-wieder-feuer-attacke-auf-der-rigaer-strasse-6acf54328793815072940386


„Es ist rund um die Rigaer Straße gang und gäbe, dass Sachen auf die Straße aufgetürmt und in Brand gesetzt werden, um Feuerwehr- und folglich Polizeieinsätze auszulösen“, kritisiert Benjamin Jendro, Sprecher der Berliner Gewerkschaft der Polizei GdP. Nicht selten würden dann aus dem Hinterhalt von Dächern Pyrotechnik, Steine und andere Gegenstände auf Polizeibeamte geworfen. „Jeder Demokrat weiß, dass Polizei und Feuerwehr in dieser Stadt genug zu tun haben und dieser sinnfreie Krawalltourismus Kräfte bindet, die woanders benötigt werden“, so Jendro weiter.

title: Filme in Erinnerung an den Beginn der spanischen Revolution vor 90 Jahren
content:
Vor 90 Jahren sorgte die spanische Revolution in aller Welt für Hoffnungen, nicht nur den Faschismus zu stoppen Die spanische Revolution war auch ein utopischer Ort für sehr unterschiedliche Linke. Wir wollen im Oktober in der K9 zwei denkbar unterschiedliche Filme zum Thema spanische Revolution zeigen.


Film 1 :


Las Libertarias, der knapp zweistündige Film widmet sich den Frauen in der spanischen Revolution. Wir sehen am Beispiel von 5 Frauen den Prozess der Emanzipation für viele Frauen, die sich nicht mehr dem Diktat von Staat und Kirche unterwerfen wollten. Viele organisieren sich in der Gruppe Mujeres Libres, eine eigenständige Organisierung von anarchistischen Frauen. author: Peter Nowak, Taz
title: Wegen antisemitismuskritischem Aushang attackiert
content:
Hans-Georg Lindenau, der in Szenekreisen nur HG genannt wird, ist seit Jahren ein Symbol des rebellischen Kreuzberg, das auch in dem Stadtteil immer mehr verschwindet. Sein Gemischtwarenladen mit Revolutionsbedarf war ein Anlaufpunkt für unterschiedliche Linke, aber auch eine Anlaufstelle für Nachbar*innen. Doch jetzt hat auch HG der Nahostkonflikt eingeholt. Gleich zweimal wurde HG in seinem Laden von einer Gruppe von Jugendlichen angegriffen. Das berichtet er der taz.


Wenige Minuten später kehrten sie zurück und schlugen mit Feuerlöschern auf sein Gesicht ein


Am 7. Oktober gegen 19.20 Uhr hätten 5 bis 6 Jugendliche den 67-jährigen Rollstuhlfahrer in seinem Laden mit Pfefferspray besprüht und ihn beleidigt. „Am nächsten Tag erschienen die Jugendlichen gegen 19 Uhr erneut im Laden und haben wieder mit Pfefferspray gesprüht“, sagt er. Nachdem er laut um Hilfe geschrien habe, seien die Angreifer verschwunden. Doch wenige Minuten später kehrten sie zurück und schlugen mit Feuerlöschern auf sein Gesicht ein, was eine blutende Wunde verursachte. Am Freitagabend beobachteten Passant*innen, wie sich 8 Jugendliche mit E-Scootern vor dem Laden von HG versammeln und die Eingangstür beschädigten. HG verständigte die Polizei.


Den Anlass für die Überfallserie sieht HG in einem Flugblatt, das er seit Anfang Oktober vor seinen Laden geklebt hat. Unter der Überschrift „Kampf gegen Judenfeindschaft“ wird dort Solidarität mit den Opfern des Nova-Festivals ausgedrückt. Am 7. Oktober 2023 hatten Mitglieder der Hamas und ihre Verbündeten das Festival überfallen und Be­su­che­r*in­nen misshandelt und ermordet. Das Flugblatt zeigt zwei Fotos, auf denen die Tafel der Getöteten zu sehen ist. Daneben steht die Parole „Wir werden wieder tanzen“. Sie stammt von Überlebenden des Festivals, die damit deutlich machten, dass sie sich dem Terror nicht beugen wollen. HG hatte das Flugblatt bei dem kleinen linken Verlag Olga Benario bestellt, der israelsolidarische Materialien verbreitet.


Vom Nova-Festival und vom Tag der offenen Moschee


„Ich habe diese Plakate neben einer Einladung zum Tag der offenen Tür in den Berliner Moscheen am 3. Oktober geklebt, um deutlich zu machen, dass ich mich dafür einsetze, dass jüdische und muslimische Menschen friedlich zusammenleben und feiern können sollen“, begründete HG die Plakataktion.


Unmittelbar danach begannen die Bedrohungen. „Seit dem 3. Oktober kam die Gruppe von mindestens 5 Jugendlichen täglich in meinen Laden. Sie machten deutlich, dass sie nicht in friedlicher Absicht kamen. Doch ich schrie so laut, dass sie verschwanden“, berichtet HG gegenüber der taz. Er hält es auch für keinen Zufall, dass die Jugendlichen am 7. Oktober, dem Jahrestag des Hamas-Überfalls, zuschlugen. HG vermutet, dass die Angreifer aus einem islamistischen Umfeld kommen.


Mittlerweile hat die Abteilung Politischer Staatsschutz beim LKA die Ermittlungen wegen gefährlicher Körperverletzung, Sachbeschädigung und Beleidigung übernommen.


HG, der bereits im letzten Jahr Opfer einer Überfallserie war, hofft aber auch auf Unterstützung von solidarischen Kund*innen. „Ich brauche Geld, um die von den Angreifern zerstörte Tür zu reparieren. Die Versicherung übernimmt die Kosten nicht“, sagt er.

author: Autonom & Traditionsbewusst
title: Solidarität mit H.G. und dem M99
content:
Letzte Woche wurde der altbekannte „M99 – Laden für Revolutionsbedarf“ in Kreuzberg mehrfach von antisemitischen Jugendlichen heimgesucht. Die Täter, attackierten den Betreiber, meist nur H.G. genannt, mehrfach mit Pfefferspray und einmal mit einem stumpfen Gegenstand und versuchten die Ladentür einzutreten. Die Jugendlichen sind H.G. teilweise bekannt und bereits mehrfach unangenehm aufgefallen. So fragten Sie ihn in der Vergangenheit in provozierender Absicht ob er „Jude sei“, und versuchten im Laden zu klauen. H.G. geht daher von einem Zusammenhang der Angriffe mit Aushängen wie „Kampf gegen Judenfeindschaft – We will dance again“ aus, die er anlässlich des 7. Oktober aufgehängt hatte.


Bereits im vergangenen Jahr wurde der Laden überfallen und HG, welcher den Laden als Rollstuhlfahrer, alleine, nur mit Hilfe seiner Kunden und Unterstützer betreibt, ausgeraubt.


Es ist ein Zeichen unfassbarer gesellschaftlicher Verrohung, die uns als Linken und Autonomen zu denken geben sollte. In Griechenland kennt man den Begriff des „sozialen Kannibalismus“ wenn man sich am Leid anderer erfreut bzw. die eigene Wut und Not der Verhältnisse in ein nach unten treten ausartet. Wir plädieren dafür, uns als Linke mehr mit diesen Dynamiken zu befassen. Eine klare Kante gegenüber Kriminalität, die sich nicht gegen die Herrschenden richtet, sondern die eigenen Nachbarn, muss wieder in die autonome Diskussion aufgenommen werden. Wir glauben hier z.B. in den 80er Jahren mit klaren Ansagen gegenüber Drogendealern im Kiez schon mal weiter gewesen zu sein.


Umso schlimmer, dass „Linke“ aus der Palästinabubble maßgeblich daran beteiligt sind den Saatboden für solche widerwärtigen und feigen Angriffe zu bereiten. Just an jenem 07. Oktober marschierten wie bereits im Jahr zuvor „Linke“ in einer Einheitsfront mit Islamisten und türkischen Faschisten um das Hamas-Massaker vor 3 Jahren zu feiern.


H.G. hat viel Erfahrung mit Angriffen gegen seinen Laden, bis vor ca. 15 Jahren ging diese allerdings meist von Polizei und Staatsanwaltschaft aus wegen autonomer Bastelanleitungen. H.G.: „Ob antisemitische Übergriffe oder Polizeirepression – ich mach immer weiter!“


Nehmt euch ein Beispiel daran. H.G. freut sich am meisten wenn Leute da sind, insbesondere wenn er Abends in der Dunkelheit seinen Laden abschließt. Ihr könnt auch einfach davor oder im Café nebenan chillen.


Keine Querfront mit Hamasniks – Antisemiten aufs Maul


Solidarität mit H.G. und dem M99!

author: Free Mumia Berlin
title: Internationaler Tag zur Abschaffung der Todesstrafe – Kundgebung in Berlin
content:
Am 10. Oktober war der Internationale Tag zur Abschaffung der Todesstrafe. Ursprünglich 2003 von der Weltkoalition gegen die Todesstrafe (

https://worldcoalition.org/

) ins Leben gerufen, gab es grade in der EU breite politische Unterstützung für das Anliegen. 2007 schlossen sich der Europarat und die EU an, um dieses Anliegen auch staatlicherseits mit Aktionstagen zu verstärken. Inzwischen sind autoritäre Debatten dermaßen bestimmend, dass die grundsätzliche Verteidigung von Menschenrechten zumindest in der Bundesrepublik kein Anliegen von Regierungspolitik mehr zu sein scheint. 2026 fand in Berlin z.B. nur eine einzige Veranstaltung zu dem Thema statt, und zwar als Protestkundgebung vor der US Botschaft, einem der Henkerstaaten in der Welt. Aufgerufen hatte Free Mumia Berlin.


Triggerwarnung: es geht in diesem Beitrag um einige extrem verstörende Details im Zusammenhang mit Hinrichtungen in den USA


Ursprünglich war die Kundgebung direkt vor der Botschaft auf dem Pariser Platz aufgerufen worden, aber der Versammlungsbehörde fiel erst drei Tage davor auf, dass ja das „Festival Of Lights“ am gleichen Ort stattfinde und untersagte die Kundgebung am seit Monaten angekündigten Ort (

https://de.indymedia.org/node/865538

). Schließlich einigten sich Veranstalter*innen und Behörde auf die Rückseite der US Botschaft am Stelenfeld in der Behrrensstr. als Ausweichort.


Ob es an dem Hickhack um den Ort, den vielen anderen Themen am gleichen Tag oder aber allgemeiner Apathie lag – es kamen trotz gutem Wetter und sichtbarer Mobilisierung in verschiedenen Berliner Stadtteilen lediglich knapp 40 Teilnehmende für eine Stunde an die US Botschaft. Dabei hätten grade die Nachrichten der vergangenen Woche über die zweifach verpfuschte Hinrichtung gegen Christa Pike in Tennessee oder die Ankündigung von US Kriegsminister und ex-Guantanamo Schließer Pete Hegseth, am 3. Dezember 2026 eine föderale Hinrichtung im Internet streamen zu wollen, die Dringlichkeit dieser Kundgebung kaum deutlicher machen können. Die 2024 erfolgte Wiedereinführung der Gaskammer als Hinrichtungsmethode im US Bundesstaat Alabama ist hierbei medial noch gar nicht präsent.


Als Eröffnung wurde ein Brief des Todestraktgefangenen Keith LaMar aus Ohio (USA) in deutsch und englisch verlesen, in dem er die Bedeutung von Unterstützung und Solidarität betonte, sowohl unter Gefangenen selbst (er berichtete über Mumia Abu-Jamals Vorbild), als auch von draußen und über Kontinente hinweg. Sein Brief ist hier beigefügt. Glücklicherweise ist inzwischen seine ursprünglich für Januar 2027 angesetzte Hinrichtung um drei Jahre verschoben worden, was mehr Zeit lässt, diesen staatlichen Mord endgültig zu verhindern und ihn zu befreien.


Danach gab Free Mumia Berlin (

https://das-mumia-hoerbuch.de/

) einen Überblick über den rapiden Anstieg der Hinrichtungen in den USA seit Trumps Machtantritt, 55 allein in diesem Jahr. Außerdem beleuchteten sie kurz die Internationale Entwicklungen in Bezug auf das staatliche Terrorinstrument Todesstrafe und gingen der Frage nach, was in Zeiten des autoritären Sogs so attraktiv an brutalen Strafdiskursen sei? Nicht verwunderlich begann dieser Diskurs beinahe handgreiflich direkt am Rande der Kundgebung, als zwei offensichtlich stark alkoholisierte Besucher des Festival Of Lights mit altbekannten Naziparolen die Teilnehmer*innen anpöbelten und erfolglos versuchten, eine Drohkulisse aufzubauen. Wer die Entwicklung nachvollziehen möchte, kann das in dem ebenfalls beigefügten Redebeitrag nachlesen.


Zwischendurch gab es immer wieder Lieder von dem Album „Freedom First“ (

https://www.albertmarques.com/freedomfirst

), dass der Gefangene Keith LaMar, selbst Dichter und Musiker zusammen mit dem Jazz Pianisten Albert Marques und zahlreichen anderen Musiker*innen mit Texten über das Überleben im Todestrakt sowie die rassistischen und klassistischen USA aufgenommen hat: „Those without the Capital get the Punishment“.


Es folgte ein Bericht über einen im August 2026 veröffentlichten Offenen Brief von Gefangenen, Ex-Gefangenen, Lehrenden und Wissenschaftler*innen aus den USA an die Politischen Gefangenen im Iran (original im Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/ng-interactive/2026/aug/20/iran-political-prisoners und dt. übersetzt im nd https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/1201991.dokumentiert-offener-brief-zwischen-zwei-klingen-einer-schere.html ), den u.a. Angela Davis, Mumia Abu-Jamal und Dan Berger unterzeichneten. Sie beschrieben …

title: Sortie de SEUM 14 : dynamiques & perspectives du mouvement
content:
Le Seum est un journal pour la révolution ici et partout dans le monde. Les articles sont rédigés et discutés de manière collective. La parution est un peu chaotique. Ce journal est un outil d'agitation et de propagande révolutionnaire anarchiste-communiste. Il est gratuit et imprimé à des milliers d'exemplaires... Et peut-être bien plus, si vous nous aidez à répandre le Seum, l'imprimez et le distribuez autour de vous

 

!


On sort ce nouveau numéro à chaud, tandis que le mouvement parti des lycées s'amplifie et ça nous réjouit de ouf

 

! Ci-dessous, vous trouverez le lien vers le numéro en

PDF

, puis une tentative de panorama des dynamiques et perspectives du mouvement, comme part d'un cycle de lutte en cours.


Le lien du

PDF

 ici


Lutte de classe en France, épisode 2026


Cette nouvelle saison commence fort. En quelques semaines, nous voilà face à toutes les dynamiques et les limites du paysage actuel de la lutte dans ce pays.


On l'écrivait dans

SEUM

 #11

 : le niveau de la lutte des classes dans ce cycle ouvert en 2016/18, est resté longtemps figé le jeudi 6 décembre 2018.


Ce jour-là, des flics filmaient des lycées de Mantes la jolie, mains sur la têtes, en s'exclamant «

 

voilà une classe qui se tient sage

 

». C'était en plein mouvement des gilets jaunes et ce moment était le symbole d'un tournant crucial. Celui de la contre-attaque du Pouvoir.


La semaine entre le premier et le 8 décembre, trop de celles et ceux qui se tâtaient à rejoindre le mouvement, ont été refroidis devant la violence déployé quotidiennement par l'État, dans la rue face à nous et les menaces répétées dans les médias, d'amplifier encore cette violence policière jusqu'au meurtre.


Le mouvement

GJ

 a dû faire avec la fin de son extension et peu à peu, nous somme sortis de l'offensive. Depuis, une grande partie de la classe est restée hantée par la répression des gilets jaunes.


En clair : l'État se fout des manifs


Alors beaucoup se sont précipités sur la manif de masse et en 2023 elles ont été immenses, éléphantesques, ces manifs. Tout cela dans le déni le plus aveugle d'un fait que pourtant les gouvernements de Macron, comme ceux d'avant lui, nous ont balancé avec le mépris qu'il charrient : ils s'en foutent complètement des manifs de masse, autant que des pétitions en ligne, c'est d'ailleurs au fond un peu la même chose.


Jusqu'à ce que ce mépris éclate à coup de 49.3, que le déni craque et que la rue se radicalise au bout de deux mois d'un mouvement des retraites très passif.


Mais presque aussitôt, il y a eu Sainte Soline, la manif contre les mégabassines, où la répression s'est refermée comme un piège sur toute une fraction, parmi les plus à l'offensive, du mouvement des retraites. Et là aussi, à Sainte Soline et face au mouvement des retraites, le spectacle de la répression autant que ses conséquences pour les blessés, ont joué le rôle attendu par l'État : le retour à l'ordre.


Et la révolte pour Nahel a surgi


Pourtant, à peine quelques mois plus tard, l'offensive a repris. Et elle est partie des jeunes prolétaires, des quartiers périphériques. Ils et elles se sont reconnus en Nahel et se sont soulevés contre la police et son État, contre le racisme et l'oppression, poussant le curseur de la lutte des classes peut-être plus haut encore que durant les premières semaines du mouvement

GJ

. Des centaines, des milliers de pillages, d'attaques de bâtiments... Mais le mouvement est resté isolé. Et cette offensive n'a duré que quelques jours de flammes. Comme durant les émeutes 2023, la dynamique de la lutte part des jeunes, et en particulier des jeunes prolétaires de l'enseignement professionnel et techniques, celles et ceux promis à l'auto-entreprise, à l'apprentissage, méprisée par le pouvoir et ses flics, sous la chape de plomb d'une répression toujours plus violente et raciste. Et comme un incendie, la colère se répand ensuite a l'ensemble des lycées, des universités, jusqu'à faire trembler l'État et c'est beau.


Bien sûr, il y a un contexte.


L'été 2026 fut étouffant, comme une fenêtre sur un futur où l'on suffoque, chez soi, au taf ou dans les établissement scolaire et jusqu'aux prisons et aux Ehpad. La répression s'accroît toujours d'avantage. L'État interdit toujours plus et cible les jeunes pour leur «

 

apprendre la vie

 

» à sa manière sadique. Car il pue fort tout de même, ce sadisme, dans les médias, chez les politiciens et les flics.


Ces gens-là bandent de joie mauvaise en promettant …

title: AYM'den 26 siyasi parti hakkında suç duyurusu kararı
content:
Anayasa Mahkemesi (AYM) 26 siyasi partinin mali denetimine ilişkin 30 ayrı kararını Resmi Gazete'de yayımladı. Eksik belge, hesap uyumsuzluğu ve kayıt dışı gelir gider işlemlerinin tespit edildiği belirtilen dosyalarda Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığına suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına, bazı dosyalarda ise Ankara Valiliğine bildirim yapılmasına karar verildi.

AYM'nin siyasi partilerin mali denetimlerine ilişkin kararları, 15 Ekim 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı. Denetimlerde ağırlıklı olarak 2024 yılı hesapları incelenirken bazı partilerin 2022 ve 2023 yıllarına ait mali kayıtları da değerlendirildi. İncelemelerde gelir ve gider kayıtlarının eksik tutulduğu, mali tablolar arasında uyumsuzluklar bulunduğu ve denetim için gerekli belgelerin sunulmadığı belirtildi. Bazı partilerin kesin hesaplarının yetkili organlarca onaylandığını gösteren belgeleri de ibraz etmediği kaydedildi.

AYM, genel merkez ve il teşkilatlarının kira, elektrik, su ve telefon gibi olağan giderlerinin hesaplarda yer almamasını da değerlendirdi. Kararlarda, bu eksikliklerin hesap dışında gelir-gider işlemleri yapıldığına işaret ettiği yönündeki tespitlere yer verildi.

Siyasi Partiler Kanunu’nun 111’inci maddesinin birinci fıkrasının (c) bendi uyarınca, mali denetimi engelleyen eylemler nedeniyle Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığına suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verildi. Bazı dosyalarda ise parti sorumluları hakkında işlem yapılması için Ankara Valiliğine bildirimde bulunulması kararlaştırıldı.

AYM'nin yayımladığı kararlar kapsamında yer alan siyasi partiler şunlar:

Küresel Adalet ve Liyakat Partisi

Türkiye Ekonomi ve Kalkınma Partisi

Türkiye Emekliler ve Emekçiler Partisi

title: Taksitli satışlara yeni düzenleme: Ticaret Bakanlığı ek sınırlama getirebilecek
content:
Duygu Ayber Gültekin [email protected]

Ticaret Bakanlığının perakende ticarette taksitli satışlara ilişkin düzenlemesinde değişiklik yapıldı. Resmi Gazete’de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe giren yönetmelik değişikliğiyle Bakanlığın, konut satışları dışındaki mal ve hizmet satışlarında taksit sürelerini belirleme ve ek sınırlamalar getirme yetkisinin kapsamı genişletildi.

Ticaret Bakanlığı tarafından hazırlanan Perakende Ticarette Uygulanacak İlke ve Kurallar Hakkında Yönetmelikte Değişiklik Yapılmasına Dair Yönetmelik, 15 Ekim 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı. Değişiklikle, 6 Ağustos 2016 tarihli ve 29793 sayılı Resmi Gazete’de yayımlanan yönetmeliğin 12/B maddesinin birinci ve ikinci fıkraları yeniden düzenlenirken üçüncü, dördüncü ve beşinci fıkraları yürürlükten kaldırıldı.

Yeni düzenlemeye göre Ticaret Bakanlığı, konut satışları dışındaki taksitli mal ve hizmet satışlarında taksitlendirme sürelerini belirleyebilecek ve bu konuda ilave sınırlamalar getirilmesine yönelik kararlar alabilecek.

Bakanlığın yetkisi yalnızca satış sırasında yapılan taksitlendirmelerle sınırlı kalmayacak. Satışın ardından belirli bir ücret karşılığında borcun taksitlere bölünmesi ve ödemenin ertelendiği dönemler de düzenleme kapsamında değerlendirilecek.

Satışın kıymetli evrak düzenlenerek ya da düzenlenmeden gerçekleştirilmesi, söz konusu hükümlerin uygulanması bakımından farklılık yaratmayacak.

Bakanlığın taksit süreleri ve ek sınırlamalara ilişkin kararları, Bakanlığın internet sitesinde ilan edilecek ve üst meslek kuruluşlarına gönderilecek.

Yönetmelik değişikliğiyle yeni bir taksit sayısı ya da süre sınırı belirlenmedi. Bu konularda karar alma yetkisi Bakanlığa verildi. Konut satışlarını kapsam dışında bırakan düzenleme, yayımlandığı 15 Ekim 2026 tarihinde yürürlüğe girdi. Yönetmelik hükümlerini Ticaret Bakanı yürütecek.

title: Telif gelirlerini "Palestine Action" grubuna aktaracağını duyurmuştu: İrlandalı yazar Sally Rooney'nin kitapları, İngiltere'de satıştan kaldırılıyor
content:
Fotoğraf: Frank Barat/Wikimedia Commons CC BY 4.0

"The Guardian" gazetesinin haberine göre, "Normal İnsanlar" ve "Arkadaşlarla Sohbetler" adlı eserleriyle tanınan İrlandalı yazar Sally Rooney, Palestine Action'a kamuoyu önünde verdiği destek nedeniyle İngiltere'deki kitap satışlarından telif ücreti alamadığını belirtti.

Yazar Rooney, "Palestine Action"ın Temmuz 2025'te İngiltere'de terör örgütü ilan edildiğini, ertesi ay ise gruba desteğini sürdüreceğini belirten görüş yazısı kaleme aldığını hatırlattı.

Rooney, "Eserlerimin İngiltere'de yayımlanmasına yönelik sözleşmelerin yerine getirilmesi artık ciddi suç teşkil edebilir. İstişare ve değerlendirme sürecinin ardından, benim de tam onayımla, yayınevim Faber eserlerimi artık İngiltere'de satışa sunamayacağına karar verdi." ifadelerini kullandı.

Yazar, inançları ve niyetleri konusunda kamuoyuna karşı dürüst olmak için elinden geleni yaptığını dile getirerek, "Bunun sonuçlarını kabul etmeye tamamen hazırım." ifadesine yer verdi.

Rooney'nin İngiltere ve İrlanda'daki yayınevi Faber de yaptığı açıklamada, mevcut İngiltere mevzuatı nedeniyle yazarın ülkedeki kitap satışlarından elde ettiği gelirin kendisine aktarılamadığını bildirdi.

Açıklamada, "Bir yazarın eserlerini satıp kazancını kendisine aktaramamak, bir yayınevi açısından kabul edilemez bir durumdur." ifadesine yer verildi.

Yayınevinin açıklamasında, bu nedenle, Rooney'nin tam onayıyla eserlerinin İngiltere'de hiçbir formatta satışa sunulmaması kararı alındığı belirtildi.

Ayrıca, açıklamada, yayınevinin, Rooney'nin eserlerini yayımlamaktan gurur duyduğu ve kitaplarının diğer ülkelerde satışına devam edileceği kaydedildi.

İrlandalı yazar Rooney, geçen yıl iki romanının İngiliz yayın kuruluşu BBC'deki uyarlamalarından elde ettiği telif gelirlerini, "Palestine Action" grubunu desteklemeye devam etmek için kullanacağını bildirmişti.

Rooney, İngiltere'nin Palestine Action'ı yasaklamasına rağmen gruba desteğini sürdüreceğini vurgulayarak, "Eğer İngiltere devleti bunu terörizm olarak görüyorsa, belki de faaliyetlerimi finanse eden WH Smith ve BBC gibi kuruluşları da incelemeli." ifadesini kullanmıştı.

Yazar Rooney, gözaltına alınma endişesi nedeniyle ödül almak üzere İngiltere'ye yapmayı planladığı ziyareti de iptal etmişti.

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: ‘Dropping 3 impeachment articles vs Duterte compromises accountability’
content:
Photo by Carlo Manalansan/Bulatlat

The Senate impeachment court granted the prosecution’s manifestation to drop three articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte as it wanted to focus “on what is necessary.” For progressive groups, however, this move undermines calls for accountability.

“Ultimately, the prosecution chose political convenience over true accountability,” said human rights lawyer and former Bayan Muna Party-list Rep. Carlos Isagani Zarate in a statement.

After its earlier manifestation to drop Article III, which accused Sara of bribery, on October 13, the prosecution decided to also drop Article I (alleged misuse of confidential funds) and Article IV (assassination threats). Lead prosecutor Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro told the impeachment court that they would only focus on Article II which accuses the Vice President of having alleged unexplained wealth, false statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs), and prohibited business interests.

Luistro said that the prosecution has presented sufficient evidence on Article II “to stand on its own.”

Lead defense counsel Sheila Sison, on the other hand, acknowledged the prosecution’s power to withdraw its allegations but she said that the prerogative should not affect how they would counter the accusations against Duterte.

Senate impeachment presiding officer Sen. Chiz Escudero accepted the prosecution’s withdrawal of three articles, ruling that the defense panel could no longer present its evidence to the said articles as they would no longer be subject to voting.

Read: VP Sara impeachment: ‘It is now about how evidence will be used’

For anti-corruption advocate Renato Reyes Jr., this move by the prosecution is “a great disservice to the Filipino people and a huge missed opportunity,” stressing that the evidence presented on the accusation of misuse of confidential funds, for him, sufficiently established corruption.

“It is high time that we teach a lesson to those who continue to abuse their confidential and intelligence funds through fabricated reports and fictitious beneficiaries,” Reyes, who currently serves as president of the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan), wrote in a Facebook post.

Former ACT Teachers Party-list Rep. France Castro, who exposed the alleged misuse of Duterte’s confidential funds in 2023, echoed Reyes’ statement, raising questions if the prosecution’s manifestation has something to do with protecting other high-ranking officials. “Are they worried that this issue would boomerang to President Marcos?” she asked.

The Office of the President (OP) was the one that approved P125 million of the P250 million in confidential funds requested by the Office of the Vice President (OVP) to the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) in 2022, of which P73 million—part of the secret funds spent by the OVP in just 11 days—was disallowed by the Commission on Audit (COA) with finality.

Under the proposed 2027 national budget recently approved by the House of Representatives on October 12, the office of Marcos Jr. has a proposal of P4.56 billion in confidential and intelligence funds.

Human rights lawyer Ephraim Cortez viewed the prosecution’s withdrawal as a deemed acquittal of Sara. “In essence, the prosecution has given the Vice President a favor by absolving her of accountability for Articles I and IV despite overwhelming evidence that she misappropriated confidential funds amounting to hundreds of millions of pesos and made a mockery of accounting and audit procedures,” he wrote in a Facebook post. (DAA, RTS)

author: Shannia Cabuello
title: On the Fringes | Days in a life as a daughter of a farmer
content:
When I was told that we were going to visit a peasant community in San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan, I spent an entire day preparing for the rural work. I slept early for almost a week trying to fix my body clock and walked for hours to condition my legs. 


We were required to bring boots, blankets, tumblers, tupperware, and our own utensils. We were oriented to eat what’s laid on the table and to not be choosy about where we would sleep. 


I did not expect that there would be host families that would allow strangers in their homes and feed them for three days. It was surprising because these families are not wealthy people. 


They are the ones who consider 5 a.m. as late for farm work and 9 pm. for a good night’s sleep. They are the ones guarding their crops and plants from landlords and business elites. They are the ones being displaced to make way for state-funded infrastructure. 


Yet, they are also the ones that would greet you with a contagious smile, a warm meal, and a welcoming home. Unlike the landlords, they believe that land is not something to be owned but to be nurtured, loved, and shared. 


True enough, I didn’t even need the things I brought. 


Our host family, Nanay Linda, guided us to the paths where we wouldn’t slip. She offered us pillows and blankets we comfortably slept on. She would buy ice and soft drinks, offer us coffee and chocolate drinks, and provide water we can directly drink from their mugs and glasses. She would gladly cook freshly harvested vegetables and lay it on their printed plate for us. 


The things we were required to bring were stuck inside my bag, watching Nanay take care of us. When she started sharing their history of resistance, I wondered how they remained gentle. 


Sunrise


Nanay Linda’s household begins their day at 5 a.m. She will prepare coffee for Tatay then spend a short time chatting with her neighbors. When we were there, they treated us as if we were her own children. Even if that’s the first time she met us, she genuinely called us “anak.” 


“Kain na kayo, mga anak. Si Tatay n’yo ayaw pa kumain. Mamaya na raw siya.”

(Go eat now, my children. Your father still doesn’t want to eat. He says he will eat later.)


“

Sama kayo kay Ate Analyn niyo. Pupunta siya mamaya sa uma para mag-ani ng tanglad.”

(Come with your Ate Analyn later. She will go to the farm to harvest lemongrass.)


Every time she referred to her family, she made us feel as if we were part of it. 


That morning, I witnessed their bond with each other. They love to joke around and laugh. 


When one of them had a vegetable harvest, all of them would scramble for excess. The one who didn’t get any would be mocked. But none of the jokes would be taken seriously. 


They would still happily eat pandesal together partnered with the coffee they got from Nanay Linda’s kitchen. 


At 7 a.m., we joined Ate Analyn to the farm they call “uma.” We were tasked to harvest an order of 70 kilos of lemongrass. We walked for about 10 minutes before arriving at the sloped farm lands of Tungkong Mangga.


The terrain was slippery, especially when wet, and hard to climb up upon when one is not used to it. Some areas have this kind of plant called

“kalmot pusa”

 that scratches one’s skin like a cat. Most of the area was open land, with few trees they use as a shed. 


So, Ate Analyn wore long sleeves, a hat, pants, and boots. When we got there, she cut the lemongrass from the soil, dragged it down under the shed of trees, then told us the life she has been living in for decades. 


She and her cousin cut the leaves of a banana tree for us to sit on. She shook off the remaining dirt from the lemongrass, cut the dried ends, removed some roots and worms, then tossed it to a pile. She warned us to be careful, as the lemongrass can irritate and cut the skin, while easily doing all of that with a sickle and a cutter on her hands. 


We did exactly as she taught us. We encountered different bugs such as ants, worms, spiders, butterflies, and caterpillars. We experienced going back and forth through slopes carrying bunches of lemongrass. Wearing our long sleeves, we still got scratches and cuts from it. We felt thirsty but their house is nowhere near. 


At last, our pile of lemongrass reached at least 15 out of 70 kilos. 


Ate Analyn told us to take a short rest before she accompanied us to their house. I was happy because I would finally be able to take a bath. At about 10 a.m., we got home.

author: Dominic Gutoman
title: Workers win illegal dismissal case vs Lazada, manpower agencies
content:
In two separate cases, the National Labor Relations Commission (NLRC) has ruled in favor of platform workers in illegal dismissal cases against manpower companies and leading Southeast Asian e-commerce platform Lazada.

Both cases involve illegal dismissal and non-payment of the 13th month pay.

Josiah David Quising, legal representative of the platform workers in two separate cases, declared that “these victories are important because of the evolving nature of the workplace.”

“We are no longer traditional wherein workers are situated in one physical space, it also extends to the digital space,” Quising told Bulatlat in Filipino.

NLRC is an attached quasi-judicial agency of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) mandated to resolve labor and management disputes involving Filipino workers.

“These winning cases are mere reaffirmation of the rights of platform workers, particularly riders, based on the Supreme Court (decision),” Quising added.

The first case was an illegal dismissal with claims for non-payment of the 13th month pay, cash bond deposit, damages and attorney’s fees by a platform rider against Metro Courier Inc. (MCI) and Lazada.

The NLRC stated that the rider is a “regular employee of respondent Lazada and that he was illegally dismissed by the latter.”

The rider was employed by the manpower services MCI for Lazada. His regular work routine was described as follows: he would wait for his assigned delivery schedule early in the morning, between 4 am to 7 am, which he would proceed to the designated hub, wait for the parcels to arrive, and proceed to sorting to delivery.

Even before completing all deliveries, the complainant was required to deposit the payments collected from customers between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. He would return to work to complete his remaining deliveries, often working until 8 p.m. to 10 pm, depending on the volume of parcels.

The rider received an email informing him of the termination of his contract on March 26, 2025, without any hearing or prior notice of dismissal. The termination letter alleged that the rider committed following violations: false delivery, commission of a crime, and tampering with parcels.

The impact of the rider’s sudden termination was severe, since it transpired when his youngest child was hospitalized.

“As a result of the loss of his employment, Complainant (rider) and his family incurred substantial debts, and his three children were unable to attend school due to lack of money for daily expenses,” the NLRC statement of facts read. “The complainant and his family also struggled to meet basic needs, including food and housing, and eventually lost their rented residence due to their inability to pay rent.”

Lazada said that there was no employer-employee relationship between the rider and the company as he was engaged by MCI to provide services. MCI also said that it does not have an employment relationship with the rider, insisting that the NLRC does not have jurisdiction over the illegal dismissal case.

However, the NLRC cited the 2023 Supreme Court ruling that declared that Lazada platform riders are regular employees and that all four factors in the four-fold test were present: (a) the employer’s selection and engagement of the employee; (b) the payment of wages; (c) the power to dismiss; and (d) the power to control the employee’s conduct.

Read: Outdated labor policies in app-based employment

“As respondent companies Metro Courier Inc. and Lazada were engaged in the prohibited labor-only contracting scheme, they are jointly and severally ordered to pay complainant his separation pay, backwages, 13th month pay, service incentive leave pay, holiday pay, damages and attorney’s fees,” the NLRC ruling added.

The second case was filed by three platform workers against J. Alcabasa Enterprises and General Services, a manpower company that provided services for shipping company J&T Express. The three workers were deployed to the latter company.

They were illegally dismissed on January 31, 2026, without valid cause, notice to explain, nor “genuine” hearing prior to their dismissal. They were barred from entering the premises of J&T Express a day before their last day, January 30, 2026.

The notice of conferences only started in February 2026 onwards, by the J. Alcabasa Enterprises and General Services, when their illegal dismissal was already in effect.

title: Ankara-Bakü başörtüsü krizi: Bahçeli egemenlik vurgusu yaptı, Aliyev İsrail Cumhurbaşkanıyla görüştü
content:
Azerbaycan Cumhurbaşkanı İlham Aliyev'in başkanı olduğu Yeni Azerbaycan Partisi (YAP), okullardaki başörtüsü yasağına karşı çıkan Erdoğan'ın başdanışmanlarından Oktay Saral'ı ve AKP milletvekillerini hedef aldı.


Aliyev 13 Ekim açıklamasında Ankara'yı Azerbaycan'ın içişlerine müdahale etmemeye çağırdı. Bir gün sonra MHP Genel Başkanı Devlet Bahçeli, Türk devletleri arasındaki ilişkilerin egemenliğe ve iç hukuka saygı temelinde yürütülmesi gerektiğini açıkladı.


Bahçeli, 14 Ekim'deki yazılı açıklamasında, “Her bir Türk Cumhuriyeti kendi içinde müstakil ve egemen bir devlettir” dedi. Türk devletleri arasındaki işbirliğinin “karşılıklı saygı, eşitlik ve ortak menfaatler” temelinde geliştiğini belirtti; 30 Ekim'deki Türk Devletleri Teşkilatı zirvesinde Cumhurbaşkanları Erdoğan ve Aliyev'in buluşacağını hatırlattı.


YAP: “Bir millet, iki bağımsız devlet”


YAP'ın 13 Ekim açıklaması, iki ülkenin ilişkilerinde sıkça kullanılan “Bir millet, iki devlet” formülüne ayrı bir yorum getirdi:


“Bu ilke, bir devletin diğerinin içişlerine müdahale etmesine veya kendi siyasi ve ideolojik yaklaşımlarını dayatmasına hiçbir biçimde dayanak oluşturmaz.”


Açıklamada Türkiye'deki bazı iktidar yanlısı medya kuruluşlarının Azerbaycan hakkında “gerçeğe aykırı, taraflı ve karalayıcı” yayınlar yaptığı öne sürüldü. Saral'ın ve AKP milletvekillerinin sözleri “popülist ve sorumsuz” olarak nitelendirildi.


YAP, başörtüsü gibi hassas konuların Azerbaycan'a siyasi baskı amacıyla kullanılmasını reddederek Erdoağn'ın Genel Başkanı olduğu "AKP iktidarını" uyardı:


“AKP iktidarını bu zararlı siyasetten kaçınmaya çağırıyoruz.”


Parti, İslam dünyasında hiçbir devletin diğer Müslüman halklara iradesini dayatma veya kendisini üstün görme hakkı bulunmadığını savundu. Bu arada, Türkiye'yle tarihsel dostluğu ve ortaklığı sürdürme isteğini de bildirdi. 


Yasak metninde “başörtüsü” sözcüğü yok


Azerbaycan Bakanlar Kurulunun 21 Eylül'de değiştirdiği devlet okulu kıyafet kuralları, üniformanın bütünlüğünü bozan veya laik eğitim ilkesine aykırı görülen ek kıyafetleri yasaklıyor.


Kurallarda başörtüsünden açıkça bahsedilmese de, uygulamada başörtülü öğrencilerin ve öğretmenlerin okula alınmadığına ilişkin tanıklıklar ve görüntüler yayımlandı. Ekim başında öğretmenlerin kıyafetlerine ilişkin yeni düzenlemeler de yapıldı.


Azerbaycan İçişleri Bakanlığı, protestolar sırasında kamu düzenini bozdukları gerekçesiyle 37 kişinin gözaltına alındığını açıkladı. Buna karşılık, yeni kurallara karşı ders boykotları ve gösteriler de devam etti. 


Bakü'de 23 yıldır İngilizce öğretmenliği yapan Gülşen Aliyeva, El Cezire'ye hem kendisinin hem kızının başörtüsü nedeniyle okula alınmadığını anlattı:


“Dini inancımın çalışmama engel olmasına meydan verilmeden görevimi yapmak, öğrencilere ders vermek ve mesleğimi sürdürmek istiyorum.”


Aliyeva, çalışma ve eğitim haklarını aramak üzere yetkili makamlara başvuracağını söyledi.


Milli Meclis İnsan Hakları Komitesi Başkanı Zahid Oruj ise “Okul dışında başörtüsü takılması yasak değil” diyerek düzenlemenin amacının eğitim ortamında ortak kıyafet kurallarını korumak olduğunu savundu.


Muhalefetteki REAL Partisi Başkanı Natiq Caferli, öğrenciler için uzlaşma aranmasını isterken şunları söyledi:


“Öğretmenler yetişkindir; nasıl giyineceklerine kısıtlama getirmek yanlış bir yaklaşımdır.” 


Ankara'da aynı cepheden farklı sesler


Cumhurbaşkanı Başdanışmanı Oktay Saral, 12 Ekim'de X hesabından “İnancı gereği başını örten bir öğrenciyi okul kapısında bırakmak hangi vicdana, hangi adalete sığar?” diye sordu.


“Başörtüsü engel değil, inancın gereğidir.”


Saral, Bakü'den kararını geri almasını istedi. AKP milletvekilleri de yasağa itiraz etti. 


AKP Sözcüsü Ömer Çelik, 7 Ekim'de Türkiye ile Azerbaycan'ın arasına girilmesine izin vermeyeceklerini söylemişti. MHP lideri Bahçeli 14 Ekim açıklamasında iki ülkenin kendi iç hukukuna saygı vurgusu yaptı. Cumhur İttifakı'ndan Saral'ın, doğrudan geri adım çağrısına karşılık Bahçeli'nin Azerbaycan'ın egemenliğine saygı vurgusu belirgin eğilim farklılıklarını yansıttı. 


Bahçeli'nin açıklamasına göre Erdoğan ve Aliyev'in 30 Ekim'de Ankara'daki Türk Devletleri Teşkilatı zirvesinde görüşmesi bekleniyor. 15 Ekim'de Bakü'de yapılacak Asya'da İşbirliği ve Güven Artırıcı Önlemler Konferansı zirvesinde Erdoğan'ı Dışişleri Bakanı Hakan Fidan temsil edecek. 


İsrail neden başörtüsü açıklamasında yer aldı?
